messages:
emma: Heads up — postmortem follow-up for last week's metering delay. We need a short plan for invoice corrections + preventing recurrence. tagging owners: @raj (eng), @maria (ops).

raj: ok, quick status: delayed batches were due to the kafka consumer lag spike + an edge case in token dedup. I've got a repro and a patch for the backfill job. planning a canary tomorrow.

maria: thanks. ops will run the backfill once raj's canary looks green. need ETA for when invoices can be reissued.

emma: goal: customers affected should see corrected invoices within 2 weeks. if backfill completes earlier we can expedite.

raj: current plan (short):
- patch consumer to skip duplicate commits (PR #4523) — owner: raj — target: EOD tomorrow
- canary backfill on staging then prod (small cohort) — owner: raj + ops — target: +24h after PR
- full backfill with throttling and monitoring — owner: maria — target: +72h after canary

alex: product asks: what's the rollback plan if backfill overruns or causes spike? we can't risk double-credits.

raj: rollback: stop backfill, revert consumer change (fast), and run integrity check script to detect duplicates. also we will snapshot ledger before full run.

maria: ops will add a circuit-breaker: stop if write rate > X or if mismatch rate > 0.5%. I'll add runbook steps.

billing-bot: SYSTEM: invoice_reissue_job queued for 27 accounts, estimated window 2-3h per batch. job_id: irj-2033-07.

emma: action items summary (for next sync):
- raj: land PR + canary (due: 2033332199)
- maria: prepare runbook + circuit-breaker + schedule window (due: 2033332300)
- alex: draft customer comms + refund/credit policy language (due: 2033332400)
- emma: coordinate finance approvals for reissue (due: 2033332500)

raj: quick note about recurring pattern — saw similar lag spike 3 months ago during a metadata compaction. I filed a follow-up ticket to correlate compaction schedules with consumer lag. ticket: ENG-7781.

maria: we'll add an alert on consumer lag + compaction overlap.

emma: good — add it to the postmortem action tracker. we'll review in the weekly incident retro. :thumbsup:

alex: one more ask: include a short FAQ for CSMs explaining why token counts changed and how credits are calculated. keeps support tickets down.

raj: will attach SQL query used for reconciliation to the ticket. snippet:```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum FROM usage_events WHERE processed_at BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2023-06-07' GROUP BY account_id;
```

emma: perfect. thanks everyone — sync at 11:30 tomorrow to confirm canary start.

maria: I'm on it.

billing-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC may affect backfill timing.

emma: okay will coordinate windows and ping legal/finance if reissue falls into restricted period.

raj: ending thread with PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523. ping me for early review.

maria: ack.
